extracted.name: Picante
extracted.description: Warm up with this chilli-infused cocktail. If you like a margarita, you’ll love this fiery, tequila-based drink where sweet honey balances the spice
ingredient_lines: ½ red chilli plus a slice to garnish
instruction_lines: Put the tequila, coriander and chilli in a cocktail shaker, and bash with a muddler or the end of a rolling pin to release the chilli oils.
Add the honey, lime juice and a handful of ice. Cover the shaker and shake until the outside feels cold.
Dampen the rim of a tumbler and dip in salt. Strain in the cocktail and garnish with a slice of chilli to serve.
